nodes.label: warn_once documented contract

nodes.label: Enumerate integer, bitflag and key-value modes
nodes.description: Supports offsets, bitwise permission combinations, mapping keys/values and StrEnum backport for Python <3.11.
nodes.norm_label: enumerate integer, bitflag and key-value modes

nodes.label: setup_logger_format documented contract
nodes.description: Supports thread_info, multiprocessing_info, extra_info and update_format=True.

nodes.label: Exception traceback and hostname context
nodes.description: log_exception and exception_to_string include type, message, traceback and origin/hostname context.

nodes.label: Conditional logging verbosity masks
nodes.description: log_if and level-specific shortcuts gate messages via booleans or integer bitmasks.
nodes.rationale: Adds finer control than a single severity threshold when enabling separate operational categories.

nodes.label: rolled_up_frame documented contract
nodes.description: Hierarchical multi-level sums; at least two groupby columns; tg_key, tg_parent, _level and num_rows describe rows.

nodes.label: PDYaml tree_init lifecycle
nodes.description: Initialization happens after tree construction and parent links; factory methods recommended for nested structures.
nodes.rationale: Inline creation of children before parents can run initialization too early for inherited values and computed fields.

nodes.label: PDYaml automatic instance names
nodes.description: Missing names use class name plus a global counter; dictionary keys override child names.

nodes.label: PDYaml hierarchical configuration model
nodes.description: Pydantic BaseModel extension adds YAML loading, auto-naming, parent references, inherited defaults and serialization.

nodes.label: PDYaml Python compatibility requirements
nodes.description: Requires pydantic v2 and pyyaml; Python 3.8/3.9 requires eval-type-backport per guide.

nodes.label: PDYaml.get_value hierarchical defaults
nodes.description: Search order: own non-None attributes, own default_values, recursive parent lookup, default argument.

nodes.label: Legacy ionbus.yaml_utils imports in YAML examples
nodes.description: Several examples use ionbus.yaml_utils while other guides import ionbus_utils.yaml_utils; namespace should be checked against current source.
nodes.norm_label: legacy ionbus.yaml_utils imports in yaml examples

nodes.label: PDYaml automatic parent-child tree
nodes.description: Singleton, list and dict fields receive parent references; dictionary keys become child names.

nodes.label: Pydantic v2 validation and serialization interoperability
nodes.description: Supports standard field/model validators, aliases, constraints, computed fields and configuration.
nodes.norm_label: pydantic v2 validation and serialization interoperability

nodes.label: PDYaml create and YAML factory methods
nodes.description: create(), from_yaml_string() and from_yaml_file() preserve subclass typing; file method also accepts HTTP/HTTPS/FTP URLs.
nodes.norm_label: pdyaml create and yaml factory methods

nodes.label: PDYaml deterministic serialization contract
nodes.description: model_dump, model_dump_json and model_dump_yaml serialize the tree with stable output and field ordering; parent references are excluded.
nodes.rationale: Excluding parents avoids circular references while preserving child data for round-trip workflows.

nodes.label: Hierarchical rollups for tree-grid UI
nodes.description: rolled_up_frame's tg_key, tg_parent and _level columns are designed for tree-grid UI components.
nodes.rationale: Aggregated parent-child rows provide the hierarchy required by tree-grid presentation.

nodes.label: Proposed shared ionbus_utils.agent_skill installer
nodes.description: Architecture proposal describes a stdlib-only install/show CLI in ionbus_utils.agent_skill. This document alone does not establish that this module is implemented.
nodes.rationale: One shared installer avoids per-package reimplementation; installation explicitly targets one import package.

nodes.label: Proposed explicit destination and platform scope
nodes.description: Exactly one of --project PATH or --user, and explicit --platform claude/codex/all are required.
nodes.norm_label: proposed explicit destination and platform scope
nodes.rationale: A future platform addition should not silently broaden filesystem writes of old commands.

nodes.label: Canonical entry point filename casing
nodes.description: Proposal reserves uppercase README*.md, AGENTS.md and SKILL.md; topical docs stay lowercase.
nodes.rationale: Exact casing preserves cross-platform references; Windows case-only renames need an intermediate path.

nodes.label: Explicit Python environment selection
nodes.description: Proposed installer uses the invoker's selected interpreter rather than choosing or activating an environment.
nodes.rationale: Different environments may contain different package versions, so automatic selection could resolve the wrong installed guide.

nodes.label: Proposed skill write preflight and atomic replacement
nodes.description: Proposed installer validates all destinations and resources before writing, refuses conflicts without --force, and uses a temp file plus os.replace().
nodes.norm_label: proposed skill write preflight and atomic replacement
nodes.rationale: Preflight prevents known conflicts from causing partial multi-platform writes; individual atomic writes do not guarantee a cross-directory transaction.

nodes.label: Proposed relative resource path validation
nodes.description: Reject absolute paths, '..', empty path components and missing resources.
nodes.rationale: Keeps resource access within a target import package and produces interpreter-specific diagnostics.

nodes.label: Proposed deterministic generated SKILL.md stub
nodes.description: Stub runs the show command against the installed package rather than copying guide content.
nodes.rationale: Avoids stale documentation; comparing complete deterministic content provides idempotence and drift detection without a version marker.

nodes.label: Proposed import package resource contract
nodes.description: Target is an import package, with README_AI.md and linked Markdown packaged at relative locations; resource access uses importlib.resources.files().
nodes.rationale: Works for wheels, editable installs, raw checkouts and Git submodules without distribution-metadata discovery.

nodes.label: Proposed package resource validation matrix
nodes.description: Validate wheel, editable and checkout modes, Python versions, platforms, path traversal, conflicts and skill discovery.
nodes.rationale: Source-tree checks alone do not prove the built wheel or Conda artifact contains the guides.

nodes.label: Cache OpsGenie error alerting
nodes.description: Cache documentation mentions alias-based OpsGenie production alerts.

nodes.label: Cache mutable-value copy isolation
nodes.description: DataFrames, Series, dicts and lists are copied by default; default_copy=False and get_state provide reference access.
nodes.rationale: Prevents accidental mutations of cached values; no-copy state access trades isolation for performance.

nodes.label: Date-named compressed pickle cache
nodes.description: Files use .pkl.gz and YYYYMMDD naming with most-recent fallback.
nodes.rationale: Sortable names support chronological selection and compressed pickle stores multiple items in one file.

nodes.label: get_latest_cache_filename documented contract
nodes.description: Latest cache lookup uses alphabetical sorting of date-formatted filenames.

nodes.label: InMemoryCache documented contract
nodes.description: Process-lifetime singleton with hierarchical keys and a class-wide lock for concurrent operations.

nodes.label: cache_filename documented contract
nodes.description: Produces directory/prefix_YYYYMMDD.pkl.gz, accepting date-like inputs and optional wildcard preservation.

nodes.label: load_cache documented contract
nodes.description: Returns data and next callback datetime; today's cache schedules tomorrow's callback, otherwise falls back to latest; missing data raises unless allowed.

nodes.label: Cache state auto-generated keys
nodes.description: put_state can generate agk_<timestamp>_<id> and get_state returns the state without copying.

nodes.label: Command string vetting invariant
nodes.description: All command functions require properly vetted commands; Windows long-running capture may use .bat files logging to files.
nodes.rationale: shell=True command execution requires caller-controlled command composition to prevent injection.

nodes.label: Linux subprocess session and group lifecycle
nodes.description: New sessions isolate child processes; kill_proc uses os.killpg on Linux and os.kill(SIGTERM) on Windows.
nodes.norm_label: linux subprocess session and group lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Group termination provides control over descendants rather than only the initial child process.

nodes.label: Git command execution utilities
nodes.description: Return stdout strings or CompletedProcess; run_many_git_commands executes sequentially and returns success with results.

nodes.label: SubProcessPopenObject documented contract
nodes.description: Tracks command, running status, exit code and stdout/stderr; check_process attempts capture with 1-second timeout; terminate delegates termination.

nodes.label: Cross-platform popen documented contract
nodes.description: Uses shell=True; Linux also uses preexec_fn=os.setsid for process-group management.

nodes.label: Documented forceful termination limitation
nodes.description: forcefully argument documented as not implemented for kill_proc and wrapper terminate.

nodes.label: Command execution and stdout capture contracts
nodes.description: get_command_output returns CompletedProcess; get_command_output_as_string returns stdout; encoding can choose text/bytes.
nodes.norm_label: command execution and stdout capture contracts
